title: vtc-00: e2eeEnabled can be turned off mid-call
description: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md:406 lets a moderator update e2eeEnabled in either direction; true->false silently downgrades the call and lifts the server-side recording ban. e2eeEnabled is also missing from every create list despite 'call creator (at create time)'.
close_reason: e2eeEnabled added to create options; moderator may change false->true; server SHOULD reject true->false.
